answer: Because the saffron stake is held until the forge settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the reef audit lists each exposure. A farm running 188 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. An attester must stake 50% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
